title: Road Bike Tire Test: Cadex Aero Cotton 28
notes: Independent lab page read 2026-11-01 (published 2026-01-29): 28-622, specified 278 g, measured 292 g, measured width 27 mm, tubeless (tubeless-ready) with 20 ml sealant; 10.6 W at 80 psi; wet grip 75; tread puncture 46; available sizes 28-622 and 30-622. Rating 5.0/5, 'Highly Recommended'.
